info.title: OPERA Cloud Housekeeping Service API
info.description:
APIs to cater for Housekeeping functionality in OPERA Cloud.

Housekeeping enables you to schedule daily room cleaning, maintenance, and housekeeping staff activities. It provides information on room status, out of order/out of service rooms, and forecasting.

Compatible with OPERA Cloud release 26.3.0.0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Indicates maximum number of records a Web Service should return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Index or initial index of the set(page) being requested. If the index goes out of the bounds of the total set count then no data will be returned.

parameters.name: housekeepingRoomStatus
parameters.description: Simple type for room status instructions to be used in requests for fetching housekeeping rooms. Valid status values are Clean, Dirty, Pickup, Inspected, OutOfOrder, OutOfService.

parameters.name: frontOfficeRoomStatus
parameters.description: Simple type for front office room status instructions to be used in requests for fetching housekeeping rooms. Valid values are Vacant and Occupied.

parameters.name: turndownStatus
parameters.description: Simple type for turndown status instructions to be used in requests for fetching housekeeping rooms. Valid status values are Required, Not Required and Completed.

parameters.name: roomParityStatus
parameters.description: Simple type for room parity instructions to be used in requests for fetching housekeeping rooms. Valid status values are Odd and Even.

parameters.name: fetchInstructions
parameters.description: Simple type for housekeeping instructions that can be used in requests for partial operations. When ScheduedRoomMoveInfo instruction is set to true, get only the rooms with a scheduled room move, along with the associated reservation information. When false, scheduled room move information is not included in the response. The scheduled room move information will assist housekeeping associates to prioritize rooms for cleaning.

parameters.name: floor
parameters.description: The floor of room to be fetched.

parameters.name: roomType
parameters.description: Room Type of the Room.

parameters.name: roomClass
parameters.description: Room Class of the Room.

parameters.name: building
parameters.description: Building of the Room.

parameters.name: roomFeatures
parameters.description: Features of the Room.

parameters.name: daySection
parameters.description: AM Sections of the Room.

parameters.name: eveningSection
parameters.description: PM Sections of the Room.

parameters.name: reservationStatus
parameters.description: The status of the reservation to which this Room is assigned.

parameters.name: guestServiceRequest
parameters.description: Possible values for the Guest Service Status.

parameters.name: roomIdText
parameters.description: Wild Card entry for Room numbers to be Fetched.

parameters.name: excludeCombo
parameters.description: Indicates we need to exclude the combo rooms while fetching the housekeeping details.

parameters.name: cleaningPriorityOnly
parameters.description: Determines whether fetching cleaning priority rooms only.

parameters.name: scheduledRoomMovesOnly
parameters.description: This flag indicates true or false. When it is set to true, get only the rooms with a scheduled room move, along with the associated reservation information. When false, scheduled room move information is not included in the response. The scheduled room move information will assist housekeeping associates to prioritize rooms for cleaning.

parameters.name: attendantInRoomOnly
parameters.description: Query only rooms with attendant working in them.

parameters.name: taskDate
parameters.description: Date for which the Task Assignment information is required.

parameters.name: attendantInRoomOnly
parameters.description: Query only rooms with attendant working in them.

parameters.name: generateCleaningSequence
parameters.description: Setting this to true will generate a sequence based on the current condition of the room for cleaning. This sequence would be the same sequence with which the Task Companion works.

parameters.name: includeReservationInfo
parameters.description: Setting this to true will include reservation information associated to the room.

parameters.name: includeComponentRoomsInfo
parameters.description: Setting this to true will include component rooms information associated to the room.

parameters.name: includeTaskSheetDetails
parameters.description: This will include room details for the Task Sheets. If summary information is only required, then this could be set to false. If a Task Sheet Number is included in the Search and this flag is set to true, then the details for that particular Task Sheet will be returned. For all other task sheets, the IncludeTaskSheetsSummary will determine if Summary details are required or not.

parameters.name: includeScheduledRoomDetails
parameters.description: Set this to true to include reservation information associated with any scheduled room moves. Available when the Advanced Daily Details OPERA Control is active. Note: IncludeReservationInfo must also be set to true to fetch reservation details.

parameters.name: includeTaskSheetsSummary
parameters.description: Setting this to true, will return Summary information for the task sheets required. If a Task Sheet Number is included in the Search and IncludeTaskSheetDetails is set to false and IncludeTaskSheetsSummary is false, then only the Summary information for that particular task sheet will be returned. IncludeTaskSheetDetails = True, IncludeTaskSheetsSummary = True : includes all task sheets details and summary IncludeTaskSheetDetails = false, IncludeTaskSheetsSummary = True : includes only summary IncludeTaskSheetDetails = false, IncludeTaskSheetsSummary = false, Task Sheet No =null : no task sheet detail or summary for any of the tasksheets. Returns the Task Assignnment header. IncludeTaskSheetDetails = True, IncludeTaskSheetsSummary = True, Task Sheet No = XX : includes task sheets detail for XX and summary for others. IncludeTaskSheetDetails = false, IncludeTaskSheetsSummary = True, Task Sheet No = XX : includes summary for all including XX. IncludeTaskSheetDetails = false, IncludeTaskSheetsSummary = false, Task Sheet No = XX : includes summary for XX. No information for others.

parameters.name: sortByCleaningSequence
parameters.description: The rooms in the task sheet would be sorted with the cleaning sequence. The normal sort would be done based on the Default Sequence.

parameters.name: taskCodes
parameters.description: The Code for the task.

parameters.name: taskHotelCodes
parameters.description: Property for which the Task Assignment information is required.

parameters.name: taskSequences
parameters.description: Ordering sequence for display.

parameters.name: taskDescriptions
parameters.description: Description of the Task Code.

parameters.name: taskInstructions
parameters.description: Instructions for this Task Code.

parameters.name: facilityDepartureTask
parameters.description: Indicates if this task code is the Departure Room Default Task to be scheduled on the departure date of the reservations. Defining a Departure Room Default Task is available when the 'Housekeeping Task Scheduling' OPERA Control is active.

parameters.name: linenChange
parameters.description: Indicates if a linen change is necessary.

parameters.name: taskCodesBreakOutId
parameters.description: A unique identifying value assigned by the creating system. The ID attribute may be used to reference a primary-key value within a database or in a particular implementation.

parameters.name: taskCodesBreakOutIdContext
parameters.description: Used to identify the source of the identifier (e.g., IATA, ABTA).

parameters.name: taskCodesBreakOutIdType
parameters.description: A reference to the type of object defined by the UniqueID element.

parameters.name: attendantId
parameters.description: Attendant ID for which the Task Sheets are assigned.

parameters.name: taskSheetNumber
parameters.description: Specific Task Sheet number for which the information is required.

parameters.name: housekeepingRoomStatus
parameters.description: Simple type for room status instructions to be used in requests for fetching housekeeping rooms. Valid status values are Clean, Dirty, Pickup, Inspected, OutOfOrder, OutOfService.

parameters.name: guestService
parameters.description: Possible values for the Guest Service Status.

parameters.name: roomStatusToChange
parameters.description: Simple type for room status instructions to be used in requests for fetching housekeeping rooms. Valid status values are Clean, Dirty, Pickup, Inspected, OutOfOrder, OutOfService.

parameters.name: includeTaskSupplies
parameters.description: Setting this to true, will return task supplies information for the task sheets if Facility Management control is active. If IncludeReservationInfo is set to true supplies information will always be returned.

housekeepingRoomInfo.description: Collection of Housekeeping Rooms and their information as well as paging attributes.

housekeepingRooms.description: List of rooms and the room status.

totalPages.description: Evaluated total page count based on the requested max fetch count.

offset.description: Index or initial index of the set(page) being requested. If the index goes out of the bounds of the total set count then no data will be returned.

limit.description: Indicates maximum number of records a Web Service should return.

hasMore.description: Indicates whether all the records are included in the response or not. Absence of the attribute values should be consider as all rows fetched in the response.

housekeepingRoomStatusInfoList.description: Collection of Housekeeping Room Status Information.

housekeepingTaskAssignmentType.description: Contains information for all the Task Sheets generated for a particular combination of Date and Task Code.

taskCodes.description: The Task Code(s) for which the Task Sheets were generated.

taskSheets.description: List of Task Sheets generated for this assignment.

hotelId.description: Property where the Task Assignment is done.

taskDate.description: The date for which the Task Assignment is done. Date should be the current business date in most cases. Date cannot be in the past.
